name: disconnection
quote: I have no idea why you're reacting that way.
description: Inability to recognize the experience of another person or animal.

variations.name: recognized disconnection
variations.description: If you recognize that you're not connecting with the other's experience, you may feel confusion, anxiety, frustration, or other social emotions.

commentaries.quote: Disconnection is the inability to put yourself in the shoes of another. This can range from temporary exhaustion to deep-seated narcissism.
From the inside, disconnection doesn't feel like anything unless you also have a sense that you should be able to connect. Then you might feel the dissonance.

If you feel disconnected from a particular person or group, maybe it's a sign to legitimately engage with them, or maybe it's a sign to move on. If you feel disconnected from everyone, it may be worth seeking help.

conditions: The sense that you can't understand the perspective of another.
Social judgment that you should be able to.
